title: Meat, fish, eggs, dairy, fats, drinks, condiments and prepared foods
notes: Policy table (knowledge repository, operations/ingredient-hierarchy/README.md section 5) confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-24: every default stands.
baked_beans: may_contain pork because four of six catalog recipes explicitly say pork and beans, while vegetarian versions exist.
broth and bouillon: generic forms may contain chicken or beef because recipe evidence names both meats plus vegetable and unspecified stocks.
pate and liver: pate may contain pork and is made from liver; catalog liver evidence is predominantly chicken liver.
eggnog, teriyaki and Worcestershire: conservative may_contain links cover common but non-guaranteed alcohol, egg or anchovy.
whipped_topping: may contain cream because catalog evidence mixes dairy whipped cream with non-dairy branded toppings.
accepted_by remains null until the package owner personally reads and accepts every drafted entry.
